target_slot: <Subject 1> means the existing target character; remap it to an already-defined subject ID before inserting a fragment.
effect_slot: If actual effect footage is attached, define an unused <Subject N> as only the selected effect or motion extracted from that asset. Do not redefine existing IDs.
source_video_slot: <Video 1> may identify the source edit video when already defined. A bare URL is not an attached multimodal reference.
reference_transfer: Use reference footage only for selected deformation, timing and surface behavior; target identity, scene and photography stay from the source shot.
stage: Choose onset, intermediate, late, hold or reverse. Describe the visible starting and ending states. Percentage stages are artistic suggestions, not official model controls.
audio: Sound instructions are optional. source_audio_ids map to actual mixed movie soundtrack excerpts, not isolated foley. audio_sample_ids is empty in this edition. Only introduce <Audio N> for a file actually attached/enabled through the host. Preserve dialogue and music decisions; playing a preview never attaches media. Use recorded source material for samples; do not replace missing recordings with procedural or keyboard-like synthesized cues.
model_scope: These are author-created prompt fragments informed by the official H3 guide, not a MiniMax-defined import format or an empirically benchmarked optimization.
image_scope: Illustrations are generated concept examples. They are not film frames, anatomical diagrams or proof of a particular intermediate shape.
priority: Source shot constraints > explicitly requested local change > chosen species topology > selected reference effect > decorative styling.
